page.notes: No margin notes and no footnotes are printed on this page. The left and right edges show stains and show-through from the reverse, which are not transcribed. The word Patriarchām carries a macron over the a in the scan; I transcribed it as printed but the mark is faint. Hierarchām has the same faint macron. The spelling iurandum is kept as printed, the u after i not changed to v.
